text_block_list.text:
One day, I notice that Mejiro Dober<n>seems a little
down while we're<n>discussing her training.
choice_data_list: Is something wrong?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Maybe you'll feel better if you talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Well... Just stuff with my mom...
choice_data_list: Maybe you'll feel better if you talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not really trying to feel better or<n>anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm not really trying to feel better or<n>anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You don't look like you'll givethis up, so fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...All right. I'll tell you, so stop making<n>that face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Remember how I took a picture of my<n>racewear
when I got it? Well, I sent it<n>to my parents
yesterday.

text_block_list.text:
Remember how I took a picture of my<n>racewear
when I got it? Well, I sent it<n>to my parents
yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then my mom called me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She didn't say it in so many words,<n>but I could tell
she would never<n>forgive me if I lost while wearing
the<n>Mejiro family colors...
choice_data_list: You'll be fine!
You'll be fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're only saying that because it's<n>not your
problem!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Heh... Thanks. I plan on doing my<n>best, obviously.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Brrring! Brrring!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Brrring! Brrring!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh... It's from home... It might be my<n>mom...
choice_data_list: It's okay. You'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sh-shut it. I don't need your<n>reassurance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: Hello? Is that you, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: Hello? Is that you, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Dad? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Your mother called you yesterday,<n>didn't she?
She's been really upset<n>since then.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
You know, she tends to come off as<n>cold when she
has something<n>important to say—she always has.
And it always gets her down<n>afterward.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
What she really wanted to tell you<n>after seeing your
racewear, is that<n>she's looking forward to seeing
you<n>compete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Really. In any case, we're both<n>rooting for you. Just
make sure you<n>don't get hurt out there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Dad. I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Tell Mom the same for me.
choice_data_list: You should tell her yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
L-leave me alone! This is family<n>business, so don't
butt in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: N-no! It's fine!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: Was that your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: Was that your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad someone else agrees! I<n>think it's best if
you tell her yourself<n>too. Goodness, you truly are
your<n>mother's daughter...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Dad! Was that really necessary?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: Sorry, sorry. I'll talk to you later,<n>Berry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Agh! Don't call me that! Geez!

Berry?

text_block_list.text: Agh! Don't call me that! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...It's not that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She's just... kind of aloof and difficult<n>to talk to. I
don't ever know how to<n>act around her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My aunt raised me until I was three...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My mom was too busy with work to<n>take care of
me then... so we're not<n>that close now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But don't get me wrong. I know<n>she's a kind
person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I especially feel it whenever my aunt<n>talks about
the moment I was born.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She said my mom held on to me and<n>absolutely
refused to let go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's the extent of her love for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I know I need to learn how to talk to<n>her someday,
but...
choice_data_list: Let me know if there's anything I can do to help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Help? You say that like it's so easy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I might never stop pestering you for<n>help if you're
really offering, you<n>know? But... you're right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The first thing I need to do is become<n>a runner the
Mejiro family can be<n>proud of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The first thing I need to do is become<n>a runner the
Mejiro family can be<n>proud of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then I'll be able to face my mom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? Quit that! It's embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Don't call me that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I swear! I told Dad so many<n>times not to call
me that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I swear! I told Dad so many<n>times not to call
me that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But my old trainer ended up calling<n>me that too!
choice_data_list: You didn't hate it then, though, did you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That was different!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I won't listen to<n>anything you
say if you call me by<n>that name!
choice_data_list: You don't need to go that far...
You don't need to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't call me that anymore, or I'll get<n>mad! I mean
it!

You don't need to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Just don't call me that!

I won't!

text_block_list.text: Just don't call me that!
choice_data_list: I won't!
I won't!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm holding you to that promise!

mistake...
